text:
sanjay: FYI team — EU midnight change window scheduled, quiet period starts in 30m. Freeze merges at 23:30 UTC. Need owners for canary, smoke, rollback, and notes publish. Short checklist and ack please.
rachael: Ack. I9ll take canary routing and verification dashboards.
mia: Ack 9ll run the smoke matrix and sanity checks.
jordan: I9m on rollback duty. Rollback runbook is the pinned doc in release-notes.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Planned rollout: service=redwood-api, image=v3.4.2-rc1, strategy=staged-canary, start=00:05 UTC, initial=1%. Pin: v3.4.2-rc1 -> pinned by release-manager.
sanjay: Jordan, paste the short rollback steps and confirm the feature-flag for migration is OFF.
jordan: Rollback short: 1) Pause deploybot traffic shift; 2) Re-pin to stable (v3.4.1); 3) Invoke deploybot rollback command; 4) Run healthcheck script healthcheck.sh and validate 200/ok; 5) Open incident channel and tag sRE. Migration feature-flag: OFF (verified).
mia: Smoke run plan: run smoke-suite (chat flows), embeddings spot-check, billing flow sanity, latency baseline p95 < 130ms, quick tokenization regression test. Will post results inline.
rachael: Canary ramp plan: 1% -> 5% after 5m -> 25% after 15m -> pause -> 100% on green. Abort if error rate increases by >0.8% absolute or if p95 degrades by >40ms for 2 windows.
ops-oncall: Watching infra. I9ve bumped alerting sensitivity for the next hour.
sanjay: Internal release notes blurb: "v3.4.2-rc1: KV cache hit-path micro-optimizations, tokenizer edge-case fix, small scheduler tweak." Any customer-facing risk we should flag?
rachael: Call out transient warmup throttling and potential short-lived fallback-model hits during initial ramp. No breaking changes.
jordan: Also mention rollback will be fast pin -> rollback; no DB migrations in this release.
deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary started: rollout_id=rl-202603-12, target=1%, status=running. Logs:
```
[00:06:00] canary: 30 reqs, errors=0, p95=102ms
[00:07:00] canary: 90 reqs, errors=1, p95=110ms
```
mia: Smoke results: all critical flows PASS, embedding sample cosine=0.93 vs baseline 0.91, tokenization test PASS, latency p95 at 108ms.
rachael: Incrementing to 5%. Metrics look stable so far.
ops-oncall: Infra stable, GPU temperature and memory within normal. No autoscaler thrash.
sanjay: Hold on config flips for 10m post-canary. Also confirm who publishes the internal changelog and external banner.
rachael: I9ll publish internal changelog. Marketing notified for external banner. Post-rollout smoke window = 30m.
mia: Updated monitoring thresholds: abort_error_rate=1.0% and abort_latency_delta=40ms.
jordan: If abort needed I9ll coordinate the pin revert and trigger rollback. Ops will lead infra triage.
sanjay: Everyone add :eyes: when you9re actively watching the thread. I9ll stay here for the rollout.
rachael: :eyes:
mia: :eyes:
jordan: :eyes:
ops-oncall: :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary reached 5% -> status=stable. Next ramp scheduled to 25% in 10m.
sanjay: Great. Reconvene at +45m for post-rollout readout unless an abort occurs. Leave the runbook pinned and note any anomalies there.
rachael: Will post final rollout summary and link to the pinned runbook when done.
